title: Kubernetes for SysAdmins | Kelsey Hightower at PuppetConf | Talk & Demo
summary: Kelsey Hightower introduces Kubernetes to sysadmins at PuppetConf 2016, with a demo. He explains the declarative model and how it changes the contract between infrastructure and applications.
why: HN recommends it for Hightower's clear mental models, such as comparing the scheduler to Tetris and explaining why resource limits matter.

quote.text: Kelsey Hightower comparing the kubernetes scheduler to Tetris was awesome for cementing a mental model.
